'''Antona''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], Antona also shared his knowledge of investigation with others.

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Antona appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the Investigation Crew Skill trainer on Vaiken Spacedock.
